selection: First6 certified crossings in predecessor R8 core_crossings.csv; nonS=N+1, verify exact membership from existing certificate; no result-dependent selection.
formula: B(z)=i psi0(z)/2. c0(h/k)=B(h/k)+1/(pi*h)-(k/h)c0((k mod h)/h). Euclid r0=k,r1=h,r[j+1]=r[j-1]modr[j]; c0=sum_j(-1)^(j-1)*k/r[j-1]*(B(r[j]/r[j-1])+1/(pi*r[j])). Terminal c0(integer)=0. V(a/b)=-c0(inverse(a) mod b / b). Preserve inversion, gcd and sign.
pole_origin: lim_{a->0} a*zeta(1-a)=-1 in source reciprocity lhs; solving for c0 gives positive1/(pi*h) in chain.
T_split: Apply chain separately through exact verdict(8) with all gcd weights and centering; equivalently compute full q_h*q_k*gcd/(h*k)*V and independently compare small cases to(8). No absolute weights or replacing inverse residues with original Mobius weights.
J1: Before N production check every coprime1<=h<k<=2000: chain with independently evaluated primary-source analytic period function vs direct cot sum, absolute error<=1e-12. Period function defined back from same cot sums cannot be called independent. If fails STOP pole task and preserve result; no largeN runs. Increase precision to resolve numerical error only, not change formula or tolerance.
J2: For every N reported require E from split versus independently evaluated direct R8 norm formula within1e-9. Do not derive both values from identical T and call it independent. Explicitly report any computationally unavailable validation.
J_layer: J_N=pi^2 integral_(1/N)^(1/logN) F_N(x)^2/sin^2(pi*x) dx from exact smooth source; record numerical quadrature/truncation precision and convergence evidence.
Dedekind: Use strict classical s(h,k) reciprocity with its exact polynomial correction and terminal0; retain same chain and bilinear weights, report correction share with zero denominators marked undefined. Do not call its correction an Eisenstein pole at a0.
runtime_rule: Target6+6. After prereg and J1, time bounded pilot and extrapolate pair count. If projected wall time>2hours, use first3 S and paired3 nonS as task permits, record reduction. Do not force six-value C1/C2 HIT from three samples; original six-value predictions then NOT_EVALUATED unless logically falsified by observed subset. No silent truncation.

predictions_verbatim.C1: on S, |T_N^pole| ≥ 0.5·|T_N^ψ| for at least 4 of 6 values of N — 0.35
predictions_verbatim.C2: the sign of T_N^pole is the same for all 6 S-values — 0.55
predictions_verbatim.C3: on S, the pole part differs from the non-S mean by more than 3 standard deviations of the non-S values — 0.30
